name: Attachment Lubrication
description: Time-based greasing and inspection for implements and heads with no engine of their own (sweeper heads, brushcutter heads, mower decks).

reminders.title: Grease Gearbox
reminders.notes: Use the grease your manual names; don't overfill a sealed gearbox.

reminders.title: Inspect Blades / Tines
reminders.notes: Check for cracks, wear and loose fasteners.
